content_sections.heading: About BSI Publication Assistant
content_sections.text: Botanical Survey of India is a Government of India organisation under the Ministry of Environment, Forest & Climate Change, with its office at the CGO Complex, 3rd MSO Building, Salt Lake, Kolkata, West Bengal. The vacancy circular describes BSI, Kolkata, as a subordinate office under the Ministry. The Publication Assistant works in its Publication Section, handling the printing and publication of the Department's bulletins, records and reports.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The Director, Botanical Survey of India, CGO Complex, 3rd MSO Building, Block-F, 5th & 6th Floor, DF Block, Sector I, Salt Lake City, Kolkata-700064 The application consists of: The Bio-data/ Curriculum Vitae in the proforma at Annexure-I, filled in and signed by the candidate and countersigned by the employer with seal and date. The certificate at Annexure-II, signed by the Employer/ Cadre Controlling Authority with seal. The required documents named in Annexure-II (see Enclosures below). The personal data in the bio-data proforma in triplicate – only applications with this personal data will be considered. The notice does not mention what to write on the envelope or a specific postal service. The Annexure-I proforma asks for the name and address in block letters, date of birth, date of entry into service and of retirement, educational qualifications, the present post with pay scale, essential and desirable qualifications held against those required, employment history in chronological order, the nature of present employment, deputation details if any, the employer type, revised pay scale, total emoluments now drawn, whether the candidate belongs to SC/ ST, and whether the present post is held substantively, on officiating basis or on deputation/ short term contract.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The vacancy circular advertises 02 (two) posts of Publication Assistant, classified as General Central Service, Group 'B', Non-Gazetted, Non-Ministerial, in Level-06 (Pay Scale of Rs. 35400 – 112400/-). The method of recruitment for the post is "By Promotion failing which by Deputation, failing both by Direct Recruitment"; this circular invites officers on deputation. Officers of the Central Government: (a) (i) Holding analogous posts on regular basis in the parent cadre or Department; or (ii) With six years' regular service in the post in pay level-05 (Rs. 29200 – 92300/-) or equivalent in the parent cadre or Department; or (iii) With ten years' regular service in the post in pay level-04 (Rs. 25500 – 81100/-) or equivalent in the parent cadre or Department. In addition, the officer must possess: (i) Graduate from a recognised University with Botany as one of the subjects. (ii) Two years' experience of publication work including proof reading in a Government or Semi Government organization or a private organization recognized or registered under any law for the time being in force. Desirable: Matriculation with Hindi as a subject. The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation shall be not exceeding fifty-six years as on the closing date or receipt of applications. The crucial date for determining eligibility will be in accordance with the DoPT Office Memorandum F. No. AB.14017/28/2017-Estt.(RR), dated 02.07.2015. Pay: Level-06 (Pay Scale of Rs. 35400 – 112400/-). The Pay & Allowances, leave, further tenure of deputation, etc. of the deputationists are governed by DoPT OM No. 6/08/2009-Estt./(Pay.II) dated 17.06.2010, as amended from time to time. The period of deputation, including the period of deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately preceding this appointment in the same or some other organisation or department of the Central Government, shall ordinarily not exceed three years. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: BSI Publication Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: Undertake the work of printing and publication of Bulletin, Records, Reports and other publications brought out by the Department, and the work of the subordinate staff of the Section. Help and assist the Editor of Publications in the sale, printing and publication works, maintenance of up-to-date records and the smooth and efficient functioning of the Publication Section. Be the Supervisor of work in proof reading, printing etc. of the subordinate staff, and discipline. Any other duties that may be assigned from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Annexure-II, signed by the Employer/ Cadre Controlling Authority, certifies the applicant's details and lists what goes with the application: Certification that the information in the application is true, that the applicant possesses the educational qualifications and experience in the Vacancy Circular, and that he/ she will be relieved immediately if selected. Certification that no vigilance or disciplinary case is pending or contemplated against the officer. Integrity certificate. CR Dossier in original, or photocopies of the ACRs for the last 5 years duly attested by an officer of the rank of Under Secretary of the Govt. of India or above. Certification that no major/ minor penalty has been imposed during the last 10 years, or a list of major/ minor penalties imposed during the last 10 years, as the case may be. A separate sheet, duly authenticated by the candidate's signature, for employment details or additional information when the space in Annexure-I is insufficient.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The declaration in the Annexure-I proforma states that the Curriculum Vitae, duly supported by the documents submitted, will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection for the post. The notice does not mention a written test or interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many Publication Assistant vacancies has BSI announced?
faq.answer: Botanical Survey of India has announced 02 (two) posts of Publication Assistant at Kolkata, to be filled on deputation basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the BSI Publication Assistant post?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent within two months from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News dated 21-27 November 2026, which comes to about 21 January 2027.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for BSI Publication Assistant?
faq.answer: The officer must be a Graduate from a recognised University with Botany as one of the subjects and have two years' experience of publication work including proof reading; Matriculation with Hindi as a subject is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the BSI Publication Assistant deputation?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation is not exceeding fifty-six years as on the closing date or receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a BSI Publication Assistant?
faq.answer: The post is in Level-06, with a pay scale of Rs. 35400 – 112400/-; pay and allowances of deputationists follow DoPT OM No. 6/08/2009-Estt./(Pay.II) dated 17.06.2010.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the BSI Publication Assistant post?
faq.answer: Send the Annexure-I Curriculum Vitae, the Annexure-II employer's certificate and the required documents through proper channel to The Director, Botanical Survey of India, CGO Complex, 3rd MSO Building, Block-F, 5th & 6th Floor, DF Block, Sector I, Salt Lake City, Kolkata-700064.

faq.question: Q7. How will BSI select the Publication Assistant?
faq.answer: The Curriculum Vitae, duly supported by documents, will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection for the post.

faq.question: Q8. Who can apply for the BSI Publication Assistant deputation post?
faq.answer: Officers of the Central Government holding analogous posts on regular basis, or with six years' regular service in pay level-05, or ten years' regular service in pay level-04, who also meet the qualification and experience conditions.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the deputation period for BSI Publication Assistant?
faq.answer: The period of deputation, including any immediately preceding ex-cadre deputation, shall ordinarily not exceed three years.

faq.question: Q10. Can I withdraw my application for BSI Publication Assistant?
faq.answer: No. Candidates who apply for the post will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently.
